newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 184-day LTNs at 2.50 pct -- dealers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 184-day LTNs at 2.50 pct -- dealers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, sold 184-day LTNs at an overnight call money rate of 2.50 percent a month during an auction Wednesday, dealers said.
They interpreted the result of the auction as a signal that domestic interest rates could go higher in coming months.
The National Treasury Letters, due in November 15 1997, totalled 2.602 billion reais. (( -- Alexandre Caverni, Sao Paulo newsroon, 55 11 2485418))
